The store is **Pine Crossing**, and I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team.

It comes from her own post in that channel on 9 June 2026. She wrote that the morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10, so they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce the problem using the store's login. I found nothing after that saying whether it was fixed, and I told her so.

I only looked at #central-team and the shared files, which she can see too. There's no Marrow Agrisupply account folder in the files.
